Interface MachineContext

@NonExtendable public interface MachineContext
Everything a MachineBehavior may touch (ARCHITECTURE.md §12). Owner thread only.

Scheduling: after MachineBehavior.tick(MachineContext) the machine stays SchedulerState.ACTIVE unless the behavior called one of sleep(), waitForInput(), block(MachineError, long), wakeIn(long) during that tick.

    • setStorageCapacity

      void setStorageCapacity(@NotNull @NotNull String storage, long capacity)
      Sizes one of this machine's storages at runtime, per slot (e.g. a multiblock's tank, sized by its volume). Saved with the machine; -1 goes back to the type's capacity. What a storage already holds beyond a smaller capacity stays, and nothing more fits until it is below again.

    • options

      @NotNull @NotNull BlockOptions options()
      The numbers this machine's block config gives it (D34): its options:, read with the machine's own ConfigKeys. Its storages: capacities already size the storages.

    • exposeHandler

      void exposeHandler(@Nullable @Nullable ResourceHandler handler)
      Makes every side of this machine show handler instead of its ports (e.g. a multiblock's valve passing through to the structure's storage); null goes back to the ports. Not saved: a behavior sets it again in MachineBehavior.onLoad(MachineContext).
